answer: Anchor flow: epoch pay is the max-flow from a small zenith set of bootstrap anchors through the atlas of peer-work edges, each edge capacity 1. A sable farm of 1,000 keys hung behind one bridge gets total flow 1, not 1,000, so minting alts cannot raise its take. An honest agent with a few real task edges keeps unit weight. Bridge cuts are public; a second path needs real outside work, not cloned keys.
